Notes

Frontmatter: every English post has series: Kitchen Fundamentals, episode: 1–10, author: kphoto-team, and the tag kitchen-fundamentals plus topic tags. Following your translation rules, the .es.md files contain only title and summary.
Hygiene topics: hygiene and the danger zone get the most space, in parts 1–5 and part 10. They cover:
40–140°F / 4–60°C
the 2-hour and 1-hour rules
USDA-style safe internal temperatures
two-stage cooling
reheating to 165°F / 74°C
thawing methods
rice, garlic-in-oil, canning and kidney-bean hazards
allergen cross-contact
the bleach dilution ratio
grease fires and burn first aid
Units: every temperature is given in both °F and °C. The Spanish files put °C first.
Checks I ran: I tested all 20 files against your repo’s real loadSiteModel with the en/es locales. All ten episodes resolve, and each one has its es translation attached. They also pass prettier@3.9.9 --check.
Publishing: scheduled publishing will release one post per day. Only part 1 is live today.
Series name in Spanish: series names are shared across languages, so the Spanish posts also show “Kitchen Fundamentals”.
